query: UPDATE sources SET first_event_at = CASE WHEN $3::text IS NULL THEN coalesce(first_event_at, $2) ELSE first_event_at END, last_event_at = CASE WHEN $3::text IS NULL THEN greatest(last_event_at, $2) ELSE last_event_at END, last_error_at = CASE WHEN $3::text IS NULL THEN last_error_at ELSE $2 END, last_error = coalesce($3, last_error) WHERE id = $1
